adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the diff sets `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` and then unconditionally calls `usernames.split(",")`. If `usernames` is submitted as an Array (e.g. `usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b`), `split` will raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500. The code has no normalization/guard (e.g. `Array(usernames).join(",")` or `usernames.to_s`).
